## Foods & dishes
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 11 dishes, all shared with Kenya/Uganda (Kiswahili 10, Coast 9), e.g. ugali, pilau, kaimati, plantain in coconut cream, beans in coconut milk; free-text ingredients, no amounts or method, plus eating context (time of day, occasion, utensils, local-language name).
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 6 dishes (1 Tanzania-only: chipsi mayai); Wikipedia-style descriptions naming ingredients, no amounts.
- [[FmLAMA]]: 1 dish (mandazi).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault or `Backlog/`. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) is where a national or regional table would be found. Fallback: [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- Plant occurrence: [[CMAUP]] 268 plants; [[NPASS]] 1 pair.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 56 ethnobotany records (41 taxa), incl. fish poisons and snakebite remedies. [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Tanzania on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No Tanzania-only dishes, no FCT, no recipes with amounts; inland and Zanzibari cuisines are not separated.
